name: Secure Shore Data Center
notes: Carrier-neutral offshore data center in Nassau/New Providence offering colocation, high-density rack space, bare metal/VPS and private suites; public listings place it at Munnings Road, Nassau.

name: Secure Hosting Nassau IDC
notes: Nassau hosting/data-center facility on Robinson Road; Secure Hosting states it operates hosting centers in Nassau and Freeport, and directory sources list Nassau IDC as a Bahamas data center.

name: Cable Bahamas New Providence Data Centre
developer: REV Cable Bahamas Ltd. / Cable Bahamas Ltd.
notes: Operational Nassau/New Providence data centre listed at Old Trail & Robinson Dr.; DCPulse describes 3 MW gross capacity, while directory and 2013 Bahamas Financial Services Board coverage corroborate Cable Bahamas' existing New Providence data centre.

name: Cloud Carib Nassau Data Centre
notes: Cloud Carib states its data centres are in Nassau and Freeport; Data Center Map profile says the Nassau-headquartered provider uses two Bahamas-based datacenters for public/private/hybrid cloud services.

name: Bahamas Government ICT Data Center Development
developer: Department of Information and Communications Technology, Government of The Bahamas
notes: Official DICT projects page search result describes construction of a state-of-the-art data center to support Bahamas Government ICT infrastructure, marked in progress and 20% complete; page was not directly readable in crawler output, so details are limited to the official indexed snippet.
